title: Dambalii Dhiiga Qoodame
intro: Lolaan guddaan lafa irra kaʼee, Taabotni tokko tasgabbaaʼee akka yaaʼu, akkasumas lubbuun tokko filannoodhaan ala hafe mee yaadi. Raajii amma iyyuu amantiidhaan adda baafame tokkotti dhiigaan kan hidhame, namni kun bishaan yeroo dhangalaʼu doonii irra akka yaabbatu waamicha dhumaa isa mudate. Eenyummaa diduu duuba jiru saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Ani sanyii nabiyyitoota Rabbii gurguddoo keessaa tokkoo, mana iimaanaa ani dhiisee deemuu filadhe.
Bara Bishaan Badiisaa Guddaa, yeroo kufrii akka bishaanii lafa uwwise keessa jiraadhe.
Abbaan koo yommuu na waamu amantoota waliin Taabota yaabbachuu dide.
Bishaan irraa na eeguuf gaara tokkotti kooluu nan barbaada jedheen.
Guyyaa san rahmata malee wanti murtoo Rabbii irraa eegu akka hin jirre natti himame.
Dambaliin na rukutee bishaaniin liqimfame, abbaan koos maatii isaa isa qajeelaa keessaa akkan hin taane itti himame.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
